First, let's recall the product rule for logarithms:

$$
{log}_{n}⁡a+{log}_{n}⁡b={log}_{n}⁡(ab)
$$

If we factor the given expression and use the product rule for logarithms, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}4\operatorname{log}⁡2+4\operatorname{log}⁡4+4\operatorname{log}⁡8 & =4(\operatorname{log}⁡2+4\operatorname{log}⁡4+\operatorname{log}⁡8) \\  & =4\operatorname{log}⁡(2\cdot 4\cdot 8) \\  & =4\operatorname{log}⁡64.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
4\operatorname{log}⁡2+4\operatorname{log}⁡4+4\operatorname{log}⁡8=4\operatorname{log}⁡64.
$$
